blind.description: A compact stylized brick furnace/athanor. It features a rectangular red-brick base that steps inward slightly, an arched front opening with an open dark metal door, a lower ash flap, and a thick iron band with rivets girding the waist. Above the band, the structure curves into a rounded brick dome topped with a cylindrical terracotta clay chimney collar open to the interior. Textures are clean, stylized painted brick and forged iron, with interior soot darkening around the opening.
blind.from_above: A square brick base curving inward to a circular domed top with a central circular chimney opening, flanked by metal corner brackets and a small open door hinge sticking out at the front right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly thigh/waist height compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
